challenges.rationale: The burden evidence relies exclusively on a single cohort (UK Biobank).
The rare-variant association is limited to European (EUR) ancestry only.
The evidence is based on triglyceride measurements rather than hard clinical endpoints.
GWAS associations are limited to biomarkers (HDL subfractions, AST) without clinical outcomes.
